analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI slightly declined from 36.5 to 36.2, entering oversold territory. Volume also contracted to 0.77x the 5-day average, indicating a lack of direction. ADX at 31.2 suggests a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, indicating downward pressure dominance. Weekly RSI is neutral at 48.9, and weekly MACD histogram remains bullish at 13.8541, though daily MACD is improving but still in negative territory. The 52-week position at 32.1% is near the lows, but the absence of clear buy signals warrants continued observation.
